title: AAPS 3.3.0-dev-b crashes when trying to use quick wizzard
body: AAPS 3.3.0-dev-b crashes immediately as soon as you try to open the quick wizard.

comments.body: I used quickwizard on my side to test it on latest dev without any crashes (within my dev configuration with android v11, Insight pump)
I just double checked and deleted the old project, cloned it once again and made a clean build. AAPS immediately crashes as soon as I choose quick wizard. Samsung Galaxy S20 FE 5G Android 13

I don't experience this myself, but I started from scratch, and I think it may be caused by "old" QW from 3.2.x in new 3.3.x QW code. 

Can you try to go to settings > overview > quick wizard > delete old QW ?

Add new QW and see if that helps? As a workaround.
deleting the old QW entries and create new QW buttons did help indeed. thx
I don't see any crash around 12:32:30
I see crashes before but there is no stacktrace anyway.
